entities.name: Barl's Cage
entities.description: A watersilver cage forged by Barl to hold Lord Ith, strung over an abyss.

entities.name: Barl
entities.description: An artificer who forged the cage.

entities.name: Mairsil
entities.description: Imprisoned Ith in the cage with Barl.

entities.name: Lord Ith
entities.description: A powerful mage imprisoned in the cage who later destroys the Conclave in rage.

entities.name: Rag Man
entities.description: Summoned by Ith to find a rescuer.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: Brought to the Conclave by the Rag Man; helps destroy the cage.

entities.name: Conclave of Mages
entities.description: An order of mages destroyed by Ith.

entities.name: Liana of Minorad
entities.description: Summoned the cage thousands of years later.

entities.name: Jared Carthalion
entities.description: Contained in the cage by Liana.

events.summary: Mairsil and Barl imprison Ith in the cage.
events.quote: Mairsil and Barl imprisoned Ith there

events.summary: Ith summons the Rag Man to find a rescuer, and it brings back Jodah.
events.quote: The Rag Man obliged and brought back Jodah to the Conclave of Mages

events.summary: Jodah and Sima destroy the cage; Ith falls, rises again, and destroys the Conclave in rage.
events.quote: Jodah and Sima managed to destroy the cage together

events.summary: Liana of Minorad summons the cage to contain Jared Carthalion.
events.quote: it was summoned by Liana of Minorad to contain Jared Carthalion

relations.quote: Barl's Cage was forged by the artificer Barl out of pure watersilver
Mairsil and Barl imprisoned Ith there
Jodah and Sima managed to destroy the cage together
